displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists BLOOM in the LLM area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “BLOOM: A 176B-Parameter Open-Access Multilingual Language Model”. The page leaves the Main Contributors field blank, so this record does not infer individual names.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
